assets.title: 踏步与鼻口
assets.sourceAxis: Blender X=length,Y=width,Z=up; v1 all symmetric in width
assets.protectedDesign: -X nose; top covers full logical tile, heel is recessed by .25m.
assets.adapterNote: Bake actual imported FBX root/child matrices, then apply Quaternion.Euler(0,180,0) once to the source frame. Known exporter raw Unity=(-sourceX,sourceZ,-sourceY); the proper 180-degree yaw yields author=(sourceX,sourceZ,sourceY), determinant +1. All v1 pieces are symmetric about the source Y/author Z width plane. The asymmetric tread keeps its intended author -X nose. This is source coordinate adaptation, not artistic mirroring or nonuniform scaling. Actual Unity envelopes, outward triangle winding and tread nose must be checked by Engine QA.
